messages:
andrew: Heads-up — preflight check for the 21:00 UTC change window. Saw a p95 uptick on /embeddings after the canary started. error budget burn ~0.4% over last 10m. Screenshot: https://obs.example/redwood/embed-canary.png
observability-bot: Alert: embeds-route p95 +18% vs baseline; 5xx rate 0.2% -> 0.6% in last 7m. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/slo/embeds
mira: On it. Pulling the SLO dashboard now. Can you paste the canary id and model variant?
andrew: Canary id: canary-2026-03-21-q8. Model: itm-embed-128q (quantized). Traffic currently 5%.
jess: @andrew thanks — is this hitting user-facing realtime requests or just backfill/batch?
andrew: Real-time API requests mainly; batch jobs unaffected so far.
kate: Let's gate: if p95 > baseline +15% OR 5xx >= 0.5% for >10m we pause the rollout and pin back. Recommend pin to previous model version for prod traffic until we root cause.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: /pin route=embeds model=itm-embed-ht-v2 reason='p95 spike' — queued. Please confirm to execute. :eyes:
mira: Quick observation: KV cache miss rate on embed workers is +12% compared to baseline. Could be a warmup/regression with the quantized kernels (cold KV shards). If so, warming or a staggered ramp could mitigate.
andrew: Agreed. @jess can you hold the ramp to 20%? We should avoid pushing to 50% until we understand cache behavior. Also propose a canary rollback to itm-embed-ht-v2 in the canary group as a test.
jess: Holding ramp now. Kicking the pause to the deploy pipeline: `/deploybot pause canary-2026-03-21-q8`
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary-2026-03-21-q8 paused by jess at 21:06:12 UTC.
kate: I approve the pin. @deploy-bot please execute the pin for production route.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: route=embed-serve pinned -> itm-embed-ht-v2 (reason: p95 spike). Rollback plan attached: https://ops.redwood/runbooks/embed-pin-rollback.md. Notifying oncall.
observability-bot: Post-action snapshot: p95 returned to baseline within ~4 minutes of pin. 5xx back to 0.15%. KV miss rate trending down.
andrew: Great—we'll keep it pinned for the window and run a targeted warmup for the quantized variant (populate KV + dummy embeddings) overnight before retrying. PR with rollout notes & warmup job: https://git.redwood/pr/8123
jess: I'll add an entry to release notes: "quantized embed variant delayed; warmup required; will reattempt after KV cache improvements and local perf verification." Will mark change-window checklist item once stable.
kate: Thanks everyone. Filing a short follow-up to triage cache warmup + quantized kernel behavior in next week's postmortem/retro. :thumbsup:
